title: Add _stopRequested check to craft and smelt action handlers
description:
**Source:** Internal audit Sprint 60 (2026-07-11) — AG-005

The `craft` and `smelt` action cases in `MineflayerAdapter/index.js` do not check `_stopRequested`. `handleStop()` clears `cmdQueue` and cancels pathfinder, but if a craft or smelt operation is in progress, it continues to completion. The bot cannot abort a craft or smelt operation.

**Impact:** If the agent is in danger (e.g., hostile mob approaching) and sends a stop command, the bot will finish crafting/smelting before reacting. For long smelt operations (up to 40s), this is a significant delay.

**Recommendation:** Check `_stopRequested` before starting new craft/smelt operations.
